notebooks.title: Prepare a qubit, then read a measurement
notebooks.subtitle: State amplitudes, Bloch coordinates, and finite shots
notebooks.description: Normalize a qubit, compare Z and X measurements, distinguish conditional repeats from fresh preparations, and measure how shot uncertainty shrinks.
learningGoals: Translate a normalized complex state into Bloch coordinates and basis-dependent probabilities.
Separate relative phase, global phase, and conditional measurement updates.
Explain finite-shot fluctuations using repeated-run uncertainty rather than a single sample.
prerequisites: How do we describe a qubit?

notebooks.title: Build gates and recover an interference pattern
notebooks.subtitle: Unitary matrices, gate order, and phase recombination
notebooks.description: Calculate X, H, Z, Ry, and Rz operations; validate their inverses; sample an H–Rz–H fringe; and compare coherent amplitudes with a coin mixture.
learningGoals: Read a gate matrix and apply operations in the correct order.
Check unitarity and construct the inverse of a complete circuit.
Derive an interference curve and distinguish coherent preparation from a classical ensemble.
prerequisites: Prepare a qubit, then read a measurement

notebooks.title: Build a joint state and test its correlations
notebooks.subtitle: Tensor products, Bell states, and what local data miss
notebooks.description: Prepare product and Bell states with an explicit q0-left convention, compare a classical correlated mixture, test no-signalling marginals, and find entanglement that two chosen bases miss.
learningGoals: Build ordered joint amplitudes and a Bell state using tensor products and CNOT.
Separate joint correlations, conditional information, and unconditioned marginals.
Explain why named Z/Z and X/X comparisons are not a universal entanglement test or Bell-inequality experiment.
prerequisites: Build gates and recover an interference pattern
